issue.title: Phase bead stays closed as done when finalizer declaration recovery fails and its work is never committed
issue.description:
An epic phase bead can end up CLOSED as done while none of its work reaches master. Phase sase-17d.4 (deck-navigation-keys) ran `sase bead close sase-17d.4 --note "... done ..."` at 2026-09-24T01:57Z, and then its turn ended with `Finalizer declaration recovery failed`. The host never committed the diff, but the bead stayed closed. The next phase (sase-17d.5) found the gap only because `grep -rn next_deck_card src/` was empty. It re-landed the work from a rescued temp-cache diff (`~/.sase/rescue/202609/sase-17d.4-deck-navigation-keys.diff`, sha256 7572cef9...). The untracked files (pilot key tests and two PNG goldens) were lost for good and had to be rewritten.

Proposed by sase-17d.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (3) in its closing note). The same incident is written up in plan:202609/deck_splits_focus.md §0. It was routed by the sase-17d land agent.

Root cause is not diagnosed. A bead close is a separate, already-pushed bead-store write that happens before the host finalizer commits the code, so nothing reconciles the two when declaration recovery fails. Fixes that landed later in the same area (e392000cd1 live bead status at submit, 9676df028f bead-store push races, d5aa86dfc2 clean-base check failures) may or may not cover this failure mode. Recheck against current master before changing anything.

task_type_fields.impact: A land agent or a dependent phase trusts a closed/done bead whose code is missing. Untracked files (tests, goldens) are lost outright, and later phases build on work that is not on master.
task_type_fields.location: host finalizer declaration recovery vs. agent-side sase bead close (finalizer path that printed 'Finalizer declaration recovery failed')
task_type_fields.repro: Historical: sase-17d.4's agent closed its bead, then its turn ended with 'Finalizer declaration recovery failed'. master never got next_deck_card or the other deck-navigation-keys code, and the bead read CLOSED/done. Reproduce by forcing declaration recovery to fail after an agent has already run sase bead close on its own phase bead, then check that the bead reopens (or never closes) when no commit lands.
